name: v0.64.0
body:
This release improves congestion control and performance, especially on paths with packet reordering:

* Slow-start pacing now uses twice the estimated bandwidth, allowing the sending rate to double each RTT: [#5882](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5882)
* Application-data loss detection now disables packet-threshold detection after a spurious loss, avoiding repeated unnecessary retransmissions caused by packet reordering: [#5905](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5905)
* Application-data loss detection now uses an adaptive time threshold that increases after spurious losses, allowing more time for reordered packets to arrive: [#5925](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5925)
* The congestion controller now restores its congestion window and recovery state after a reduction caused entirely by spurious packet loss: [#5923](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5923)

## Notable Fixes

* Congestion recovery now respects send order across Initial, Handshake and application-data packets, fixing incorrect recovery decisions caused by comparing packet numbers from different spaces: [#5920](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5920)
* Connections now fall back to 1200-byte Initial packets on `EMSGSIZE` when `Config.InitialPacketSize` is unset, allowing handshakes over paths with smaller MTUs: [#5911](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5911)
* Oversized packets are now rejected before serialization, including Initial packets with excessively large address-validation tokens: [#5937](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5937)
* Path MTU discovery now restarts correctly after connection migration and NAT rebinding: [#5887](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5887)
* Servers now retry unanswered PATH_CHALLENGEs with exponential backoff as more packets arrive on the candidate path, preventing path validation from stalling when a challenge is acknowledged but no PATH_RESPONSE arrives: [#5930](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5930)
* Servers now continue responding to PATH_CHALLENGEs on existing candidate paths when the candidate path limit is reached: [#5929](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5929)
* Writes after closing a `SendStream` or `Stream` now return `quic.ErrStreamClosed`, which is also used as the stream context's cancellation cause: [#5885](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5885)
* `Conn.SendDatagram` now returns the connection's close error after shutdown, instead of accepting datagrams that will be silently dropped: [#5880](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5880)
* http3: `SendDatagram` now immediately returns an error after the stream's send side closes, including after STOP_SENDING or connection shutdown: [#5884](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5884)
* http3: request header, response header and trailer buffers now grow as data arrives, avoiding large allocations based solely on a peer's advertised HEADERS frame length: [#5886](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5886)
* Spurious losses are now detected when an ACK only acknowledges packets previously declared lost: [#5895](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5895)
* Spurious losses are now detected when ACKs arrive out of order: [#5900](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5900)
* Path migration now clears the old path's loss history, preventing stale spurious-loss reports and recovery adjustments: [#5903](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5903)
* MTU and path probes no longer trigger spurious-loss reports or adaptive loss-recovery changes: [#5906](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5906)

## Notable Changes

* `ConnectionStats` now exposes `CongestionWindow`, reporting the local sender's congestion window on the active network path in bytes: [#5901](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5901)
* `http3.Stream` and `http3.RequestStream` now expose `QlogTrace`, allowing applications to add events to the underlying connection's qlog trace: [#5935](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5935)
* `http3/qlog.RedactHeaders` allows applications to redact HTTP/3 header and trailer values, including pseudo-headers, before they are written to qlog: [#5932](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5932)
* qlog: locally dropped QUIC datagrams are now recorded with `quic:datagram_dropped`, including drops caused by a full receive buffer or an oversized outgoing datagram: [#5907](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5907)
* qlog: `quic:recovery_parameters_set` now records initial recovery parameters and changes to loss-detection thresholds, including resets after path migration: [#5926](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5926)

## Changelog
* return an error from Conn.SendDatagram when the connection is closed by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5880
* http3: fail SendDatagram as soon as the send side is closed by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5884
* use ErrStreamClosed instead of context.Canceled for closed streams by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5885
* congestion: pass the pacing rate explicitly to the pacer by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5881
* congestion: increase slow start pacing factor to 2 by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5882
* http3: grow header block buffers as data arrives by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5886
* ackhandler: use a fixed cap for tracked lost packets by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5888
* ackhandler: detect spurious loss when only lost packets are ACKed by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5895
* ackhandler: avoid floating point math for time threshold calculations by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5896
* ackhandler: move MaxAckDelay constant from the protocol package by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5892
* ackhandler: don’t store MaxAckDelay on the appDataReceivedPacketTracker by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5893
* congestion: move MinPacingDelay constant from the protocol package by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5889
* handshake: move the KeyUpdateInterval from the protocol package by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5891
* ackhandler: detect spurious losses in reordered ACKs by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5900
* move 0-RTT queue constants from the protocol package by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5890
* remove the fixed size cap on post-handshake CRYPTO frames by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5902
* ackhandler: clear lost packet history on path migration by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5903
* ackhandler: move packet number skipping consts from the protocol package by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5904
* expose the sender's congestion window in ConnectionStats by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5901
* ackhandler: disable packet-threshold loss detection on spurious losses by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5905
* ackhandler: exclude MTU and path probes from lost packet tracking by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5906
* fix MTU probing after path changes by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5887
* qlog locally dropped QUIC datagrams by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5907
* ci: bump CodSpeedHQ/action from 5.2.1 to 5.4.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5912
* ci: update golangci-lint to v2.14.0 by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5919
* utils: use uint32 for random number generation by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5916
* ackhandler: use a uint32 countdown for packet number skipping by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5917
* introduce a dedicated type for packet number spaces by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5921
* use packet numbers from a single packet number space by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5920
* restore congestion control state after spurious packet loss by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5923
* ackhandler: increase the time threshold after spurious losses by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5925
* fall back to 1200 bytes initial packet size on EMSGSIZE by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5911
* qlog initial recovery parameters and loss threshold updates by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5926
* README: link OSS-Fuzz badge to the introspector by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5928
* http3/qlog: implement redacting of header fields by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5932
* http3: expose the connection's qlog trace on streams by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5935
* reject oversized packets before serialization by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5937
* only enforce the candidate path limit for new paths by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5929
* retry server path challenges with exponential backoff by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5930


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/compare/v0.63.0...v0.64.0
